_readme: The machine-readable half of layouts/. Each .md file in this directory is the
archetype written for a person: where it was measured, when to pick it, image
density, pacing. This file is the same archetype reduced to what a gate can
check, so bin/assert-layout-variety.mjs never has to parse prose.
measuredFrom the live page or pages the .md file took its numbers from, all
measured 2026-09-24 at 1440 x 900. Several archetypes borrow from
more than one site, so this is an array.
opening  the fixed three every archetype starts with and none may reorder:
the hero, why our systems are the best, then a look at our systems.
catalogue is the one that takes SystemsGrid rather than Systems at
position three, because the index IS its look at our systems. The
archetype decides everything after them, and how they are treated.
requires the components this building must use, in this order, after the
opening. Missing one, or using them out of order, is not this
archetype.
forbids  the components that would break this building's character. A
diagram-led explainer with a work gallery is a photo essay wearing
the wrong name.
Only components actually exported from templates/components/sections/index.ts
appear in requires and forbids. The .md files also place interactive widgets
(ConcernRouter, PricingTable, SavingsCalculator, which live in
components/interactive) and repeated Dividers. Those are real instructions but
they are not gate-checkable here, so they stay in the prose.
homeImageFloor is the bottom of the measured home-page range the
archetype's density table gives, videos excluded.
Add an archetype here and in a matching .md file, or the gate will refuse a
build that declares it.

diagram-led-explainer.note: The mechanism is the hero: vector stages and a numbered flow carry the page, and photographs appear only as evidence for a claim the diagram already made.

photo-essay.note: Photographs carry the argument and copy annotates them, which makes this the highest media-share archetype and the only one where a section may be almost wordless.

catalogue.note: The product line is the spine: a numbered index of uniform cut-outs, a sticky rail, and specifications where another archetype would put a story, for a reader expected to scan rather than read.

proof-led-local-trade.note: Trust signals and interactive tools stand in for photography, which is the archetype for the client who has credibility and coverage but no usable pictures.

editorial-long-read.note: The tallest building: chaptered rather than sectioned, numbered rather than listed, with full-bleed media bands as punctuation and a named human at the centre.
